content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Elevated 429s observed for tenant delta-orbit in their VPC/dedicated pool (pool-id: dp-42). Traffic spike started ~1725004400; error rate ~18% over last 10m. Auto-retries causing queue pressure. Tagging oncall.
oncall-jen: I’m on it. Can someone paste the quick metrics link and whether this is regional (us-west2) only?
sre-eli: https://metrics.internal/redwood/tenant/delta-orbit — spike concentrated on us-west2 in the dedicated pool. QPS up ~5x vs baseline, token rate up ~7x. Key observation: a small subset of client prefixes accounts for ~70% of requests.
eng-raj: looks like they started a nightly batch hitting long-context completions. We see long seq lengths and many concurrent streams. This overwhelms the per-tenant token budgeting.
cs-mallory: I’ve reached out to the customer (via their escalation channel) to confirm whether they kicked off a job. Waiting reply.
ops-bot: Current mitigation candidates: 1) temporary quota bump for delta-orbit (contract override), 2) apply per-tenant shaping at edge (soft 429 replacement), 3) route a fraction of traffic to spare-dedicated-pool (dp-43).
oncall-jen: Priority is to restore customer traffic without impacting other tenants. I’ll request a conservative emergency exception while we implement shaping. Mallory, any ETA from customer?
cs-mallory: Delta Orbit confirmed — they launched a data backfill unintentionally due to a bug. They approve a temporary raise for 2 hours while they throttle their job.
sre-eli: Ok. Recommend combined approach: (A) apply a temporary contract override raising token allowance from 1.2M/min to 3M/min for 2h, (B) enable edge shaping to smooth bursts, (C) drain heavy prefixes to dp-43 with gradual traffic shift.
eng-raj: I can push the traffic diversion. Command I’ll run: ```
# shift 20% of delta-orbit traffic to dp-43
rk route set --tenant delta-orbit --percent 20 --target-pool dp-43
```
ops-bot: Executing quota change requires approval. Oncall, please confirm scope/time.
oncall-jen: Confirmed. Approve emergency override: delta-orbit +3M/min tokens for 2h. Ops, apply edge shaping with `priority=soft` to convert hard 429s to backoff hints for 15 minutes while reroute completes.
eng-raj: Starting reroute now — shifting 20% to dp-43. Expect transient errors during drain.
sre-eli: Enabling shaping at gw-ingress for tenant: `shaper set delta-orbit mode=soft window=60s`.
ops-bot: Contract override applied by billing-flow: +3M/min for 2h (override-id ov-9981). Reroute job kicked off by eng-raj. Shaping enabled.
sre-eli: Monitoring: 5m after mitigations — 429 rate down from 18% -> 4.5%, overall latency stable. Heavy prefixes reduced, KV cache hit ratio improved.
cs-mallory: Delta Orbit confirms job throttling on their end. They will pause the remaining backfill in 30m. Appreciate the quick coordination.
oncall-jen: Great. Keep an eye on dp-43's tail latency — we don't want to move the problem. Raj, any signs of overload on dp-43?
eng-raj: dp-43 showing ~12% higher CPU but memory/KV usage within bounds. No OOM or degraded instances. Will stop reroute if it degrades.
sre-eli: Next actions: 1) Gradually roll down override at t+90m and remove at t+120m, 2) revert shaping after 30m of stable 429 <1%, 3) run post-incident check for per-tenant adaptive limits. I’ll create the follow-up ticket.
ops-bot: Metrics snapshot (5m window) attached: ```
{ "pre_mitigation": {"429_pct": 18, "qps": 2400},
  "post_mitigation": {"429_pct": 4.5, "qps": 2100}
}
```
cs-mallory: Customer asked for short note they can use internally: "Redwood applied temporary quota and routing to stabilize traffic; Delta Orbit paused their backfill job." Sent.
oncall-jen: Thanks team. Standby for final confirmation — if stable for 60m we close and hand back to CS for follow-up.
sre-eli: 60m stable check passed at 1725007200. Rolling override down now: setting to +1M/min for next 30m.
ops-bot: Override reduced; final removal scheduled at 1725011567.
eng-raj: Reverting reroute to baseline (removing 20% diversion).
sre-eli: Shaping disabled. Final 10m 429 rate at 0.6%. Latency normal.
cs-mallory: Customer confirms all good and resuming normal ops with patched backfill job. They asked for a follow-up runbook entry.
oncall-jen: Closing incident thread. Follow-ups: (1) postmortem (assigned to eli), (2) add an alert to detect unusual long-context token spikes per tenant, (3) update playbook for combined override+routing steps. Mallory — please own customer comms.
sre-eli: Will draft postmortem and include timeline + action items.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: status=resolved, reason="temporary contract override + routing + shaping", resolved_ts=1725007389. :white_check_mark:
